title: Elementary school and fifty violin lessons on Saturdays
summary: After elementary school near home, Cobb enters Phillis Wheatley High and takes a mail-order style deal of fifty violin lessons at a downtown Houston building, getting the violin free.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

And, of course, as time grew for a couple of years there, they formed a band. I was interested in the band, but by the same token they had a project like a lot of people do come to the schools to sell you an idea to take 50 lessons at a dollar a lesson once a week for 50 weeks, you get the violin free.
